paragraphs: In Eruvin 7b we find him before Rav Chisda; Rashi reads Rav Yeiva the Elder. In Ketubot 53a he asked Rav Nachman a question, and Rava said to him, “Then you should also ask,” etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Ketubot paragraph explicitly says Rav Yeimar asked Rav Nachman. Rava addresses Yeimar in the reply.

The consulted Ketubot 53a paragraph explicitly has Rav Yeimar Saba asking Rav Nachman, followed by Rava addressing him. The reported Eruvin 7b occurrence and Rashi's Yeiva reading were not established by the bounded checks here. The names and literal locator remain Hyman's report; no Mar-son-of-Nachman identity is supplied.
